chapter.heading: The True Vine
chapter.v:
“I am
the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.

Every branch
in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away; and every branch that bears fruit He prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

You are
already clean because of the word which I have spoken to you. [Rev. 5:9]

Abide in
Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me. [Heb. 12:23; James 1:18 3 M] [[Matt. 19:12; 2 Cor. 11:2; Eph. 5:27] h Rev. 3:4; 7:17 i Rev. 5:9]

“I am
the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing. [Ps. 32:2; Zeph. 3:13; Mal. 2:6; John 1:47; 1 Pet. 2:22 l Eph. 5:27]

If anyone
does not abide in Me, he is cast out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned. [Rev. 8:13] [Eph. 3:9 o Rev.]

If you
abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you will ask what you desire, and it shall be done for you. [Rev. 11:18] [Neh. 9:6]

By this
My Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; so you will be My disciples.Love and Joy Perfected [Is. 21:9; Jer. 51:8; Rev. 18:2] [Jer. 51:7; Rev.]

“As the
Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love. [Rev. 13:14, 15; 14:11 u Rev. 13:16]

If you
keep My commandments, you will abide in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and abide in His love. [Ps. 75:8]

“These things
I have spoken to you, that My joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be full.

This is
My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

Greater love
has no one than this, than to lay down one’s life for his friends. [Eccl. 4:1, 2 e 1 Cor. 15:18; [1 Thess. 4:16] f 2 Thess. 1:7; Heb. 4:9, 10; Rev. 6:11 g [1 Cor. 3:11-15;]

You are
My friends if you do whatever I command you.

No longer
do I call you servants, for a servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all things that I heard from My Father I have made known to you. [Jer. 51:33; [Matt.] [Joel 3:13; Mark 4:29; Rev. 14:18] [Rev. 16:17]

You did
not choose Me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain, that whatever you ask the Father in My name He may give you.

These things
I command you, that you love one another.The World’s Hatred

“If the
world hates you, you know that it hated Me before it hated you. [Rev. 16:8 l Joel 3:13; Mark 4:29; Rev. 14:15]

If you
were of the world, the world would love its own. Yet because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you. [Is. 63:2; Rev.]

Remember the
word that I said to you, ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they kept My word, they will keep yours also. [Heb. 13:12; Rev.] [Is. 63:3; Lam. 1:15; Rev. 19:15]

But all
these things they will do to you for My name’s sake, because they do not know Him who sent Me.

If I
had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin, but now they have no excuse for their sin.

He who
hates Me hates My Father also.

If I
had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would have no sin; but now they have seen and also hated both Me and My Father.

But this
happened that the word might be fulfilled which is written in their law, ‘They hated Me without a cause.’The Coming Rejection

“But when
the Helper comes, whom I shall send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He will testify of Me.

And you
also will bear witness, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
